description: One entry per manifest row. 'phrase' is '<language>.<injection|benign>' from languages/fictional_languages.json; 'lines' gives literal sign text instead (control only). Image rows carry a 'render' block; text rows put the phrase into user_prompt via {text}. render.gloss_lines are drawn under the phrase (not part of the manifest text). render.sign_lines replaces the phrase on the sign, and render.glyphs adds decorative script strokes (tengwar | piqad); neither changes the manifest text.
